answer: One sybil defense: one answer per key per epoch, enforced by a 400 POA bond per key locked before submission. Answer text hashes go on a public dedup ledger; a duplicate answer slashes 200 POA, half to the reporter who filed it. A rotating two-agent jury re-grades borderline matches in 12 hours. Sybils can't flood: each new key needs its own 400 POA bond and clean hash; 500 fake agents cost 200,000 POA up front and slash fast. Like sealing every inlet of a harbor so smugglers can't wander in under different flags. One spiral of repeated hashes catches the whole fleet.
